source_changes: Only report/documentation attachments; native source unchanged

hardware.background: Desktop graphics processes present; no other compute jobs observed at preflight

gate_result: Complete measurement matrix and validation passed; no prespecified performance threshold

scopes.evolution: meta.timing.total_ms; engine wall time including backend setup and population initialization; excludes CLI parsing/loading/serialization
scopes.generation: timing.generation_total_ms[0]; one complete generation; excludes initialization
scopes.fixed_pop: Canonical repository scope: generation plus gpu_eval_init_ms for GPU; reproduction-resource first-touch may occur outside this scope
scopes.process: /usr/bin/time whole-process elapsed seconds converted to ms; 10 ms reporting resolution

aggregation: For each population, mode and seed, median of 5 repeats; report median of 3 seed medians. Speedups are paired by seed before median/min/max; min/max are not confidence intervals.
historical_comparison: See historical-audit.json: the 30x historical frozen migration benchmark used a different grammar, population, budget and allocator on the same Snoopy hardware; this new scalar matrix cannot establish a performance regression against it.
